frontMatter.title: The Race to Become the Context Layer for Agents
frontMatter.summary: The next data platform may be less about storing data and more about deciding what AI agents should know, trust, and act on.

next.title: Building from Zero After Addiction, Prison, and a Felony
next.summary: I spent ages 14-16 in a maximum-security juvenile prison, became a felon at 19, lost almost everything to addiction, and later rebuilt my life through software, open source, and a few people who took a chance on me. This is the condensed story, written for anyone wondering whether they have a future.
